item.title: Vulnerability Prioritization Matrix
item.description:
Project Summary

Managing vulnerabilities efficiently requires more than just looking at a CVSS score. This project involves a custom Python script that aggregates data from multiple frameworks (CVSS, SSVC, EPSS, and CISA KEV) to generate a realistic prioritization queue.
